title: Apui lam meuligoe sombong .
intro: Di likôt bintéh rajek meuligoë njang paléng meukuasa di dônja jameun njan tinggai sidroë tokoh njang ateuëh djih djimeu-ulang-ulang saboh rahasia njang hana djeuët djipeuseungap lé peurintah raja. Seudangkan ban sikeulileng jisujut ubak dewa-dewa palsu, jiwa nyoe jikeubah iman nyang seungap nyang meututong lam até. Peunguasa nanggroe nyan geu peucaya droe geuh bahwasajih droe geuh ilahi, namun ureung nyoe geu pileh kebenaran dibandengkan kenyamanan, dan bakti dibandengkan keselamatan. Bak uroë njoë, tugaih droëneuh nakeuh neuteumeung soë jiwa njang beuhe njoë, njang kisah djih teutap djeuët keu salah saboh contoh njang paléng meukuasa keu iman njang hana meu-ulang-ulang.
clues: Lon tinggai di teumpat nyang that kaya dan keubeusaran nyang hana meutandingan, dipat peunguasa nanggroe nyan na kuasa mutlak ateuh mandum.
Seudangkan ureuëng-ureuëng nyang na di sikeulileng ulôn jisujut ubak dewa-dewa palsu, ulôn lôn jaga saboh cahya iman nyang seungab lam até ulôn.
Lon teumeung dan lon adopsi sidroe aneuk miet nyang jiba keu lon deungon cara nyang hana biasa - kon deungon cara lahe, tapi rot ie krueng nyang rayeuk.
Lon meudo’a bak Tuhan lon, lon lakee rumoh to ngon Gobnyan di Firdaus dan keuseulamatan nibak tirani nyang meulingka lon.
Aneuk miet nyang lon peubeudoh rayeuk keu ji tantangan penguasa nyang that-that jikuasa nasib lon, dan lon teudong teuga lam iman lon bahpih watee ji ancam.
Lon nakeuh ureueng nyang nan jih geuhoreumat lam Al-Quran seubagoe model iman, dan lon tinggai di meuligoe Firaun keudroe.

identity.label: Soe Lon?
options: Asiya peurumoh Fir'aun .
Maryam, mak nibak Nabi Isa .
Bilqis, Ratu Syeba .
Isteri Nabi Lut AS .
Peurumoh Imran nyan .

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Meuteumeung dan meupeubeudoh sidroe aneuk miet nyang ka jitinggai nyang jeuet keu nabi nyang rayeuk .
Dipeutron lam apui nyang rayeuk le sidroe tiran .
Menyaksikan ie raya nyang peuhanco saboh bansa .
Meusaksikan goyang kurma dan geubri nutrisi .
Meuhamil aneuk agam meskipun umu ka tuha .
trial.answer: Meuteumeung dan geupeubeudoh sidroe aneuk miet nyang ka jitinggai nyang jeuet keu sidroe nabi nyang rayeuk .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Saboh meuligoë raja nyang meugah hana meutandingan .
Kapai raya nyang geupeugot keu tahan banjir .
Saboh guha nyang dalam that nyang teusöm lam gunong .
Apui nyang meu-ulang-ulang geupeudong ateueh pucok gunong .
Saboh taman nyang jikeulileng lé bintéh .
location.answer: Saboh meuligoë raja nyang meugah hana meutandingan .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Saboh rumoh geubri lam Firdaus ateuh kehendak Allah .
Saboh ie raya nyang peuhanco ureueng kaphé saboh kawôm jameun .
Saboh keurajeuen nyang that rayeuk kuasa dan otoritas geubri lam donya nyoe .
Saboh teuntra nyang teuga jipeuceu-ceu lé cicém nyang teungoh jiplueng .
Sidroe tiran nyang meungaku keutuhanan ka keunong lam laot .
outcome.answer: Saboh rumoh geubri lam Firdaus ateuh kehendak Allah .

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
